title: DECLARE DIVINE PEACE AND JOY OVER YOUR MORNING
text: Beloved, I want you to do me a favor this morning before we go deep into the things of the spirit. I need you to share this prayer point with somebody. Send it to your family members. Send it to your colleagues. Send it to that friend that has been battling with anxiety and fear. There are people in your contact list right now who need this word, who need this atmosphere, who need this declaration spoken over their lives. Don't keep it to yourself. The Bible says in Proverbs that a word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver. Somebody needs what God is about to release here. So quickly share this now and let's proceed. I want to talk to you this morning about something that the enemy fights against consistently in the lives of believers. You see, the devil understands a principle that many Christians have not yet grasped. When your morning is settled, when your morning is established in the peace of God and the joy of the Lord, the rest of your day flows from that foundation. The enemy knows that if he can disrupt your morning, if he can inject anxiety into the first hours of your day, if he can steal your joy before you even step out of your house, he has successfully set the tone for everything else that will follow. This is why many believers wake up and the first thing they encounter is worry. The first thing that greets them is fear. The first thought that enters their mind is a problem that is not accidental. That is a strategy of darkness. But I have come in the authority of the name of Jesus Christ to declare that your mornings will no longer be a battlefield of worry. Your mornings will no longer be dominated by fear and anxiety. From today, every single morning of your life shall be saturated with the peace that passes understanding and the joy that is unspeakable and full of glory. The scripture is very clear in Psalm 30:5. Weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning. You see, God designed the morning to be a season of divine visitation. Morning is when fresh mercies arrive. Lamentations 3 from verse 22 says, "His mercies are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." So God has already predetermined that every morning should be a package of fresh mercy, new grace, renewed strength, and supernatural joy. But the enemy wants to hijack what God has packaged for you. I need you to understand that peace and joy are not just emotions. They are spiritual weapons. In Nehemiah 8:10, the Bible says, "The joy of the Lord is your strength." Joy is not just about feeling happy. Joy is a force. Joy is an empowerment. Joy is a dimension of strength that the enemy cannot withstand. When you carry the joy of the Lord, you become unmovable. You become unshakable. Circumstances may scream, challenges may roar, but joy keeps you anchored in the purposes of God. And peace, beloved, peace is not the absence of chaos. Peace is the presence of God in the midst of chaos. Jesus said in John 14 27, "Peace I live with you. My peace I give unto you." Not as the world gives, give I unto you. The peace that Jesus gives is not dependent on whether your account balance is good or bad. It is not dependent on whether you got that promotion or not. It is not dependent on what the doctor's report says. The peace of Jesus is anchored in the finished work of the cross. It is anchored in the covenant. It is anchored in his word that cannot fail. So this morning I am standing in the office of a prophet in the authority of the priesthood of the believer and I am declaring peace over your morning. Not just today's morning but every morning that you will ever experience from this day forward. I am breaking every cycle of anxiety that has been attacking you at dawn. I am shattering every pattern of fear that has been greeting you when you wake up in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree that peace is your portion. You know there is something that happens in the spiritual realm during the hours of the morning. The Bible records that Jesus would rise early in the morning to pray. Mark 1:35 says he rose up a great while before day and went out into a solitary place and there he prayed. Jesus understood the importance of setting the spiritual atmosphere of the day through early morning communion with the father. If the son of God needed to establish his mornings in prayer, how much more do we need to when you wake up and the first thing you do is grab your phone and start scrolling through bad news. You are feeding your spirit with poison. When the first thing you do is begin to worry about all the things you need to do, you are setting the wrong altar. But when you wake up and the first thing you do is worship, the first thing you do is declare the word, the first thing you do is pray, you are establishing divine order over the rest of your day. I prophesy over your life right now that God is giving you a new grace for morning devotion. Laziness will no longer dominate your mornings. Slumber will not steal your mornings. You will wake up with a hunger for God. You will wake up with a desire to pray. You will wake up with the word of God in your mouth. And as you do that consistently, you will begin to see that your days will change, your weeks will change, your months will change because the morning sets the pattern. In the book of Job, we see how Satan sought permission to attack Job. Job 1:6 tells us, "There was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them." You see, there are spiritual counsels, there are spiritual meetings, there are spiritual assignments given out against the children of God. But the Bible is clear that Satan cannot just do whatever he wants. He needed permission. And even when he got permission, there were boundaries set by God. I want you to understand that this morning there are altars speaking against your peace. There are covenants speaking against your joy. There are familiar spirits that have been assigned to torment you at dawn. But I have good news for you. The blood of Jesus is speaking better things. The blood of Jesus is crying out on your behalf. Hebrews 12:4 says, "We have come to Jesus, the mediator of the new covenant and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better things than that of Abel." Whatever has been speaking against your morning, the blood is speaking louder. Whatever covenant has been working against your peace, the new covenant in the blood of Jesus is superior. And right now in the name of Jesus, I activate the voice of the blood over your life. Let the blood speak peace. Let the blood speak joy. Let the blood speak rest. Let the blood speak mercy. Let the blood speak favor. Let the blood speak victory. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before you on behalf of everyone connected to this prayer. Lord, we recognize that you are the God of peace. Romans chapter 15:33 calls you the God of peace and we know that you desire that your children walk in peace. So, Father, I ask that you will silence every voice of chaos, silence every whisper of fear, silence every threat of the enemy, and let your peace that transcends human understanding garrison the hearts and minds of your children. I pray that as they wake up tomorrow morning and every morning after that, the first thing they will sense is your presence. The first thing they will feel is your love. The first thing they will experience is your joy. Remove every tendency toward anxiety. Uproot every seed of depression. Destroy every pattern of worry and establish them in the joy that comes from knowing you. Lord Jesus, you said in Matthew 11:28, "Come unto me all you that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest." I pray that every person hearing this will experience that rest. Not just physical rest, but spiritual rest. The rest that comes from knowing that you are in control. The rest that comes from trusting your word. The rest that comes from believing your promises. Holy Spirit, I invite you to brood over every morning just as you brooded over the waters in Genesis chapter 1:2 and brought order out of chaos. I pray that you will brood over the mornings of your children and bring divine order. Set things in alignment. Arrange things according to the will of God and let every morning be a prophetic declaration of victory. Now I want to pray a militant prayer because there are some situations that require more than just gentle petitions. There are some battles that require violent faith. Matthew 11:12 says, "From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffers violence and the violent take it by force." When the enemy is being stubborn, when demons are being persistent, when attacks are being relentless, we must arise with holy violence and take back what belongs to us. So right now in the name of Jesus, I command every spirit of fear that has been waking people up at night, I bind you and I cast you out. Every spirit of anxiety that has been creating panic attacks in the morning, I bind you and I render you powerless. every nightmare, every bad dream, every tormenting vision that has been disturbing God's children during sleep, I cancel you by the authority, in the name of Jesus Christ, every evil clock that has been set to wake people up at ungodly hours with terrible thoughts, I destroy that clock. Every spiritual alarm that has been programmed to trigger depression in the morning, I shatter that alarm. Every demonic assignment that has been scheduled to attack people are done. I abort that assignment. And I decree that from now on, every morning shall be a testimony of God's faithfulness. I speak to every source of bad news. Every phone call that was meant to bring sorrow in the morning, I cancel it. Every message that was designed to bring confusion in the morning, I nullify it. Every report that was orchestrated to bring fear in the morning, I destroy it. And I prophesy that from this day forward, your mornings will carry good news. Your mornings will carry testimonies. Your mornings will carry breakthrough announcements. There is a scripture in Isaiah 33:2 that says, "Oh Lord, be gracious unto us. We have waited for thee. Be thou their arm every morning our salvation also in the time of trouble." Did you see that? be thou their arm every morning. God's strength is available every morning. God's help is available every morning. God's salvation is available every morning. You don't have to wait till afternoon to experience God. You don't have to wait till evening to encounter his power. Every morning is loaded with divine possibility. I decree over your life that God will be your arm every morning. When you wake up, you will feel his strength. When you open your eyes, you will sense his presence. When you step out of bed, you will walk in his authority. No morning shall be wasted. No morning shall be empty. No morning shall be fruitless. Psalm 143 verse8 says, "Cause me to hear thy loving kindness in the morning, for in thee do I trust. Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk, for I lift up my soul unto thee." You see, the psalmist understood that the morning is when we need to hear from God. The morning is when we need direction. The morning is when we need clarity. And God is faithful to give us those things when we seek him. I prophesy that God will cause you to hear his loving kindness every morning. You will not wake up to condemnation. You will not wake up to guilt. You will not wake up to shame. You will wake up to the loving kindness of your father. You will wake up to affirmation. You will wake up to the voice of God saying, "You are mine. You are loved. You are chosen. You are destined for greatness." And not only will you hear his loving kindness, but he will show you the way you should walk. Every morning, divine direction will be made available to you. You will know what to do. You will know where to go. You will know what to say. You will know what to avoid. Confusion will not be your portion. Stagnation will not be your portion. Every morning will bring fresh insight, fresh wisdom, fresh understanding. Now, let me show you something powerful. In the book of Exodus, when God was leading the children of Israel through the wilderness, he gave them mana every morning. Exodus 16:1 says, "They gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating. And when the sun waxed hot, it melted." The mana had to be gathered in the morning. If they delayed, if they waited till the heat of the day, the mana would melt and they would miss their portion. There is a prophetic principle here. God has mana for you every morning. There is grace for you every morning. There is provision for you every morning. There is strength for you every morning. But you must gather it in the morning. You cannot be lazy. You cannot be casual. You cannot procrastinate. When you wake up, seek God immediately. Worship immediately. Pray immediately. Declare the word immediately. Gather your manner. I speak to every spirit of laziness. Every spirit that has been making people too tired to pray in the morning. I bind you. Every spirit that has been making people hit the snooze button instead of hitting their knees, I cast you out. Every excuse, every justification, every delay tactic of the enemy, I destroy it now in Jesus name. From today, you will hunger for God in the morning. You will thirst for his presence in the morning. You will prioritize seeking him above everything else. And as you do that, I decree that supernatural things will begin to happen. Doors will open that were closed. Opportunities will come that you never applied for. Favor will locate you in unexpected places. Because when you seek God first, Matthew 6:33 promises that all other things will be added onto you. Let me pray for your children. Father, I lift up every child, every teenager, every young adult connected to this prayer. I pray that you will visit them in their mornings. Break every cycle of rebellion that manifests in the morning. Every spirit of disobedience that is active when they wake up, cast it out. every bad attitude, every negative mindset, every wrong association. Deliver them, Father. I pray that they will wake up with the fear of God. They will wake up with wisdom. They will wake up with understanding. They will wake up with a desire to please you. Protect them from evil influences. Protect them from dangerous friendships. Protect them from every trap of the enemy. And let their mornings be filled with the joy of salvation. For those who are married, I pray for your spouse. Father, let peace reign in every marriage from the morning. Every quarrel that usually starts in the morning, I silence it. Every misunderstanding that manifest at dawn, I resolve it. Every tension, every conflict, every harsh word, I cancel it. And I decree that couples will wake up loving each other more. They will wake up appreciating each other. They will wake up speaking life to each other. I command the spirit of strife to leave marriages. I command the spirit of bitterness to leave marriages. I command the spirit of unforgiveness to leave marriages. And I release the spirit of love, the spirit of kindness, the spirit of patience, the spirit of understanding. Let mornings in the home be sweet. Let mornings in the home be peaceful. Let mornings in the home be a foretaste of heaven. For those who are single trusting God for a life partner, I declare that your mornings will carry prophetic insight. God will give you dreams. God will give you visions. God will give you instructions concerning your future. You will not make mistakes. You will not miss the will of God. You will not be deceived by the enemy. Every morning that you pray, heaven is aligning things in your favor. Heaven is preparing your spouse. Heaven is orchestrating divine connections. Now concerning your workplace, your business, your career, I speak to your mornings. Every morning that you go to work, you are not going alone. The presence of God goes with you. The favor of God goes with you. The wisdom of God goes with you. And I decree that you will excel. You will not be overlooked. You will not be bypassed. You will not be denied what belongs to you. Every conspiracy against your promotion, I scatter it. Every gang up against your advancement, I destroy it. Every plan to frustrate your efforts, I nullify it. And I decree that from this month, you will begin to see unusual elevation, unusual recognition, unusual rewards because the hand of the Lord is upon you. I declare that when you walk into that office in the morning, the atmosphere shifts. When you enter that environment, the presence of God fills the place. Your colleagues will notice something different about you. Your superiors will see the grace on your life and doors that have been closed for years will suddenly open because you carry the anointing of God. For students, I pray that your mornings will be filled with a spirit of wisdom and understanding. Every morning when you wake up to study, the Holy Spirit will teach you. He will give you insight. He will give you revelation. He will give you understanding that your textbooks cannot provide. You will not struggle. You will not fail. You will not be confused. I speak to every examination you will write. I decree that when you enter that exam hall in the morning, the spirit of wisdom will rest upon you. You will remember what you studied. You will understand the questions. You will provide the correct answers. And you will come out with outstanding results that will shock the devil and glorify God. There are some of you battling with health issues. You wake up every morning with pain. You wake up with discomfort. You wake up with symptoms. But I have a word for you from Isaiah 53:5. It says by his stripes we are healed. That word I is present continuous tense. You are healed. Not you will be healed. Not you were healed. You are healed right now. So I speak to every sickness, every disease, every infirmity, every chronic condition. I command you to leave now in the name of Jesus. From tomorrow morning when that person wakes up, let them wake up healed. Let them wake up whole. Let them wake up strong. Let them wake up with a testimony that will confound medical science. I decree that pain will cease. Inflammation will disappear. Tumors will dissolve. Blood pressure will normalize. Sugar levels will stabilize. Hearts will function properly. Kidneys will work efficiently. Lungs will breathe freely. Every organ, every tissue, every cell. I command you to align with the word of God and be made whole. And let me say this, if you have been on medication, I'm not telling you to throw it away carelessly. God can use medication. But I am saying that God is able to do what medicine cannot do. So while you take your medication, also take the word of God. While you follow the doctor's instructions, also follow the instructions of the Holy Spirit and watch God give you a miracle that will make you a living testimony. For those battling with financial challenges, I want you to know that your morning breakthrough is coming. There is a scripture in Malachi 3:10 that says, "Bring ye all the tithe into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house. and prove me now herewith, say the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it. God is saying, "Prove me, test me, try me, and see if I will not open heaven over your life." So I decree that heaven is opening over your finances. The windows of heaven are opening over your business. The windows of heaven are opening over your career. and blessings that you don't have room to contain are being poured out upon you every morning when you wake up. Expect financial miracles. Expect unexpected income. Expect divine ideas that will generate wealth. Expect favor that will bring contracts. Expect connections that will open doors. God is not limited by the economy. God is not limited by recession. God is not limited by your educational background. When God decides to bless you, nothing can stop it. I declare that debt is coming to an end in your life. Lack is coming to an end in your life. Poverty is coming to an end in your life. From this month, you will begin to experience overflow. You will lend and not borrow. You will be the head and not the tail. You will be above only and not beneath because the blessing of the Lord maketh rich and addeth no sorrow with it. Let me address those of you who have been experiencing attacks at night that affect your morning. You have nightmares. You have sleepless nights. You wake up tired even though you slept. You wake up with body pains even though you didn't do any work. These are spiritual attacks and they must be dealt with violently. So right now I take authority over every demon that visits people at night. Every incub spirit, every succubus spirit, every spirit husband, every spirit wife, I command you to lose your hold and let God's children go. Every covenant of darkness that gave you access, I break that covenant by the blood of Jesus. Every mark, every seal, every identification that you placed on God's children, I erase it by the blood of Jesus. I decree that from tonight when you sleep, you will sleep in peace. Psalm 4:8 says, "I will both lay me down in peace and sleep, for thou Lord only makest me dwell in safety." God is your security guard. God is your night watchman. God is your protector. And no weapon formed against you shall prosper. Every evil dream I cancel it. Every nightmare I destroy it. Every manipulation in the dream I nullify it. And I decree that from now on your dreams will be prophetic. Your dreams will be revelatory. Your dreams will carry divine instructions. Your dreams will show you the plans of God for your life. I want to remind you that joy is not dependent on circumstances. The Bible says in Habacook 3:1 17, "Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive shall fail, and the field shall yield no meat, the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls. Yet I will rejoice in the Lord. I will joy in the God of my salvation." Did you see that? Even when everything looks bad, even when everything seems wrong, even when there is no evidence of blessing, yet I will rejoice, this is the kind of joy that confuses the enemy. This is the kind of joy that releases the power of God. This is the kind of joy that brings breakthrough. So I decree over your life that you will rejoice regardless. You will have joy regardless. You will praise God regardless. Because your joy is not based on what you see. Your joy is based on who God is. Your joy is based on what God has promised. Your joy is based on the finished work of the cross. Father, as I bring this prayer to a close, I thank you for everyone that has been connected to this word. I thank you for the anointing that has been flowing. I thank you for the breakthrough that has been released. And I ask now that you will seal everything we have prayed with the seal of the Holy Spirit. Let it be permanent. Let it be lasting. Let it be irreversible. I declare that from tomorrow morning and every morning after that, peace will be their portion. Joy will be their strength. Victory will be their testimony. They will not wake up to bad news. They will not wake up to sorrow. They will not wake up to defeat. They will wake up to the goodness of God. They will wake up to divine favor. They will wake up to supernatural breakthroughs. Every hour of the morning is sanctified by the blood of Jesus. Every minute of the morning is covered by the blood of Jesus. Every second of the morning is protected by the blood of Jesus. And no weapon of the enemy shall prosper against them. The Lord will perfect everything that concerns them. He will complete what he has started. He will finish what he has begun. And there will not be a cast away. There will not be a casualty. There will be a career of glory. There will be a testimony to the nations. There will be a sign and a wonder in Jesus mighty name I have prayed and I know that it is settled in heaven and it is done on earth. Let somebody shout a big amen. Now go and share this prayer with someone who needs it. Don't keep it to yourself. Become a channel of blessing and watch God bless you even more as you bless others. Grace and peace be multiplied unto you in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
